description: Defines the HelpController class for handling help-related HTTP requests within the OrangeHRM system, providing redirection based on help URLs or fallback logic.

classes.name: HelpController
classes.description: Controller class handling help URL redirection requests, extending AbstractVueController.

methods.name: getHelpService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the HelpService instance used for help URL validation and redirection.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes incoming help requests, validates URLs, performs redirection, and handles exceptions or invalid URLs.
